meta.title: Full Code-Driven Video Pipeline Demo
meta.description: Comprehensive tour of procedural video primitives: hooks, mathematical Manim equations, WebGL 3D shaders, structured compare tables, stats, quotes, and outro calls-to-action.
facts_to_verify: Remotion renders deterministic frame-by-frame compositions using React components combined with WebGL shaders and vector Manim clips.

scenes.purpose: Captivate the viewer with the full diversity of code-driven animation primitives

visual.start: Deep dark void with glowing teal coordinate axes expanding in all directions
visual.action: Prism spins on its axis as neon light ribbons whip around the camera
visual.camera: Forward high-speed dolly plunging through the center of the play prism
visual.end: Camera breaks through light wall into the mathematical Manim grid

scenes.narration: यह वीडियो हमारे कोड-ड्रिवन इंजन के हर एक सीन टाइप का लाइव डेमो है। हुक्स से लेकर थ्री-डी विज़ुअल्स तक, सब कुछ कोड से रेंडर होता है।

scenes.title: Procedural Math Engine
scenes.purpose: Showcase pixel-perfect procedural mathematics powered by Manim vector rendering

visual.start: Clean Cartesian coordinate system with illuminated cyan axes
visual.action: Sine wave plots itself smoothly from left to right with glowing neon trailing line
visual.camera: Slow cinematic camera pan tracking the apex peak of the curve
visual.end: Graph rotates 90 degrees into 3D topographical terrain

scenes.narration: दूसरा है मैनम इंटीग्रेशन, जहाँ जटिल गणितीय इक्वेशन्स और स्मूद कर्व्स पिक्सल-परफेक्ट वेक्टर क्वालिटी में एनिमेट होते हैं।

scenes.title: 3D WebGL Shader Surface
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate native Three.js 3D WebGL terrain with real-time dynamic lighting

visual.start: High-altitude overview of undulating neon 3D mathematical landscape
visual.action: Surface ripples dynamically as particle probes travel down contour gradients
visual.camera: Continuous 360-degree slow orbit around the central loss crater
visual.end: Camera swoops low across the surface valley into the feature bullet cards

scenes.narration: तीसरा है थ्री डॉट जे-एस का थ्री-डी वेब-जी-एल सीन। शेडर्स, पार्टिकल्स और थ्री-डी मॉडल्स सीधे वीडियो के अंदर स्मूदली चलते हैं।

scenes.title: Core Engine Features
scenes.purpose: Reinforce the core architectural principles that guarantee high viewer retention

visual.start: Three dark frosted glass cards stacked neatly in perspective
visual.action: Cards deploy horizontally in staggered 120 BPM rhythm with pop micro-animations
visual.camera: Subtle push-in with gentle rotational tilt matching bullet pop timing
visual.end: Cards lock into unified layout before splitting into compare matrix

scenes.narration: चौथा है बुलेट्स सीन, जो बोरिंग लिस्ट्स को हाई-इम्पैक्ट विज़ुअल कार्ड्स में बदल देता है, ताकि दर्शक का ध्यान कभी न भटके।

scenes.title: Old Slides vs Code Motion
scenes.purpose: Directly compare traditional static presentation slides with dynamic code-driven motion

visual.start: Split-screen layout comparing dull monochromatic left card against vibrant glowing right card
visual.action: Divider sweeps across screen, demonstrating dramatic visual upgrade of code-driven animation
visual.camera: Orthographic slow zoom focusing on the contrast between dull text and dynamic motion
visual.end: Right card expands to dominate frame

scenes.narration: पाँचवाँ है कम्पेयर सीन। पुराने थके हुए स्लाइड्स और मॉडर्न कोड मोशन के बीच का फर्क साफ शब्दों और विज़ुअल्स में समझाइए।

scenes.label: Realtime Pipeline Rendering
scenes.purpose: Highlight rendering performance with bold full-screen metric typography

visual.start: Black background with faint neon telemetry grid lines
visual.action: Metric rolls up rapidly from 0 to 30 FPS and slams forward with electric green shockwave
visual.camera: Rapid punch-in with subtle lens vibration on impact
visual.end: Numerals lock in center screen with gentle breathing glow

scenes.narration: तीस फ्रेम्स पर सेकंड की रफ्तार से यह पूरा सिस्टम बिना किसी रुकावट के आपके वीडियो को तेजी से रेंडर कर देता है।

scenes.title: Cinematic Camera Push
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate cinematic Ken Burns camera push and lens vignette over image assets

visual.start: High-resolution architectural visual asset framed in dark border
visual.action: Smooth Ken Burns camera push-in smoothly gliding toward the focal center
visual.camera: Continuous 2.5D dolly-in with atmospheric depth-of-field blur on perimeter
visual.end: Image fades softly into quote pedestal

scenes.narration: इमेज सीन में आप किसी भी डायग्राम या स्क्रीनशॉट को सिनेमैटिक कैमरा मोशन के साथ पेश कर सकते हैं।

scenes.text: Code is the most expressive creative medium in history.
scenes.author: Antigravity Video Engine
scenes.purpose: Inspire the audience with memorable philosophy on code-driven creative expression

visual.start: Atmospheric deep navy void with floating serif quotation glyphs
visual.action: Quote text reveals smoothly word by word with glowing light sweep across the typography
visual.camera: Slow contemplative tilt-up highlighting the author citation
visual.end: Quote letters soften into background stars as outro manifests

scenes.narration: और जब बात गहरी बात कहने की हो, तो कोट सीन स्क्रीन पर एक ठहराव और वजन पैदा करता है।

scenes.purpose: Encourage audience to follow the channel for more automated video technology deep dives

visual.start: All components synthesize into a single radiant diamond emblem
visual.action: Emblem pulses with brilliant cyan energy; follow button springs into view with cheerful sparkle
visual.camera: Gentle crane pull-back into dark vignette finish
visual.end: Final elegant fade to dark-mode black

scenes.narration: यह है मॉडर्न वीडियो क्रिएशन का भविष्य। ऐसी ही पावरफुल कोड-ड्रिवन टेक्नोलॉजी के लिए चैनल को अभी फॉलो करें!
